1.w: Now we make known to you⁺, brothers, the grace of God having been given in the churches of Macedonia,

2.w: that in much proof of tribulation, the abundance of their joy and of their deep poverty abounded into the riches of their generosity.

3.w: For I testify [that] according to [their] power and beyond [their] power, of their own accord,

4.w: with much entreaty [they were] imploring us for the grace and the fellowship of the service to the saints.

5.w: And not even as we expected, but they gave themselves first to the Lord and to us by the will of God.

6.w: Accordingly, we exhorted Titus that just as he began before, so also he might complete to you⁺ also this grace,

7.w: but just as you⁺ abound in everything—in faith and word and knowledge and all earnestness and in the love from us in you⁺—that also you⁺ may abound in this grace.

8.w: I do not speak as a command, but proving the genuineness of your⁺ love through the earnestness of others also.

9.w: For you⁺ know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that being rich, on account of you⁺ He became poor, so that you⁺ by that poverty might be enriched.

10.w: And I give a judgment in this [matter], for this is profitable for you⁺, who not only began before to do, but also to will, from a year ago.

11.w: And now also complete the doing, so that just as [there was] the readiness to will, so also [there may be] to complete out of that which you have.

12.w: For if the readiness is present, [it is] acceptable as if he may have, not as he does not have.

13.w: For [it is] not that to others [is] relief [and] for you⁺ tribulation, but of equality.

14.w: At the present time, your⁺ abundance [is] for their need, so that their abundance also may be for your⁺ need, so that there may be equality.

15.w: As it has been written: “The one who [gathered] much did not abound, and the one who [gathered] little did not lack.”

16.w: But thanks to God, the One putting the same earnestness for you⁺ in the heart of Titus.

17.w: For indeed he accepted the exhortation, but being more earnest, of his own accord he went out to you⁺.

18.w: And we sent with him the brother whose praise in the gospel [is] through all of the churches,

19.w: and not only [that], but also having been appointed by the churches, [he is] our fellow traveler with this grace that [is] being ministered by us toward the glory of the Lord Himself and [to] our readiness,

20.w: avoiding this, lest anyone should blame us in this abundance being ministered by us.

21.w: For we are giving forethought to what is right, not only before the Lord but also before men.

22.w: Now we sent with them our brother, whom we proved often in many things to be earnest, but now much more earnest by [his] confidence that [is] in you⁺.

23.w: Whether as regards Titus my partner and fellow worker for you⁺. or our brothers, [they are] apostles of the churches, the glory of Christ—

24.w: the demonstration therefore of your⁺ love and of our boasting on behalf of you⁺ to them, demonstrated to the face of the churches.
